standard.summary: CLIP 分数漂移超过此值时发出警告（不干预）。默认 0.03。
standard.effect: 警告级别仅记录日志，不触发 LR 调整或训练停止，用于提醒用户注意。
standard.whenToUse: 监控训练过程中图像-文本对齐是否出现偏移，可作为过拟合的早期信号。
standard.avoidWhen: 不使用 CLIP 评分评估的训练场景可忽略此参数。

standard_en.summary: CLIP-score drift above this value raises a warning without intervening. Default 0.03.
standard_en.effect: The warning level only writes a log line; it does not adjust the LR or stop training. It exists to draw your attention.
standard_en.whenToUse: To watch whether image-text alignment starts drifting during training -- it can be an early overfitting signal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Ignore it in runs that do not use CLIP scoring at all.

advanced.principle: CLIP 漂移 = |CLIP_score_step_n - CLIP_score_baseline| / CLIP_score_baseline，反映当前生成与训练早期的文本对齐偏差。
advanced.tradeoffs: CLIP 评估本身有计算开销，频繁评估会影响训练速度。

advanced_en.principle: CLIP drift = |CLIP_score_step_n - CLIP_score_baseline| / CLIP_score_baseline, reflecting how far current generations have drifted from the text alignment of early training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: CLIP evaluation itself costs compute; frequent evaluation slows training.
